sn34.41-45:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo ca hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || Samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo || || Neva samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo hoti || na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || || Samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca || || Tatrayvāyaṃ jhāyī || pa || uttamo pavaro cāti || || Samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || pe || Samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī || pe || Samādhismim ārammaṇakusalo hoti na
